scope: Skill packaging, researcher/coordinator routing, existing read_skill/read/execute integration and permission claims. This audit does not establish live LLM behavior or scientific validation.

migration_integrity.note: All 73 current targets were read and compared to migrated_sha256/migrated_bytes. For 24 historical evaluation targets, the manifest also retains equal original and migrated fingerprints. Original pre-move bytes were not separately available to this reviewer. generated_validation is a regenerable report, not a stable historical artifact.

path_contract.skill_location_source: Parent directory of File: returned by read_skill for the selected skill name
path_contract.reference_read: Absolute path under the selected Skill references directory
path_contract.helper_execution: Configured Python interpreter plus absolute scripts/calculate_plan.py path; execute.working_dir remains the active project workspace
path_contract.relative_path_warning_resolved: Both SKILL.md and references/decisions/calculation.md now use this contract. Neither requires the project working directory to be the Skill directory.
path_contract.legacy_json_input: Optional read of an existing request file; it is not required for researcher operation

helper_source_review.result_channel: JSON on stdout with explicit success/error exit status
helper_source_review.missing_reference_behavior: RUNTIME with unresolved-axis formulas, without invented reference lengths

root_test_evidence.provenance: Root agent execution record; this reviewer inspected tests/test_phase_design_skill.py but did not rerun the tests

coverage: AgentCatalog discovers the restored researcher profile and PromptBuilder exposes the Skill
Real ToolRegistry read_skill returns the selected absolute Skill file path
Real read accesses Skill references from a different active project workspace
Real execute invokes scalar state and tension commands using the selected absolute helper path
100 ps / 0.5 fs gives 200000 steps and supplied tau/dt ratios 200 and 2000
xy loading gives independent per-axis increments 0.000105 and 0.000108 angstrom per step
Missing z reference stays RUNTIME; true strain and conflicting hard constraints return JSON errors
No request or asset files are created in the active test project workspace
The researcher profile rejects the write tool

root_test_evidence.limitation: The integration tests execute deterministic existing tool channels, rather than a live LLM delegation or an already-running application session. Scalar ramp is covered by the calculator checks, not the real-execute parametrization in the integration test file.

configuration_preservation_evidence.provenance: Root agent tool records from before its edits, rather than comparison to Git HEAD
configuration_preservation_evidence.root_record: Root checked resolved Windows source and destination paths, confirmed the active destination did not exist, and moved the whole researcher directory into profiles/researcher. It changed the description, appended execute, extended the existing evidence-research prompt, and added one coordinator routing paragraph. Other existing tool implementation changes in the worktree were not part of this integration.
configuration_preservation_evidence.reviewer_independent_limit: The final source and profile tool lists were checked; the pre-edit uncommitted filesystem state cannot be reconstructed independently from Git HEAD.

code_enforced: AgentCatalog loads immediate profiles/*/agent.yaml entries and permits configured custom-profile overlays
PromptBuilder filters visible tool and skill names by the selected profile
ToolRegistry rejects tools outside allowed_tools; read_skill rejects skills outside allowed_skills
The read tool resolves paths against allowed workspace and Skill roots
execute requires its working directory to stay within the active workspace and applies its existing general command checks
documented_role_limits_only: Researcher execute use is restricted to this Skill's existing calculate_plan.py entry
Researcher does not author replacement programs, generate simulation assets, start MD, or perform trajectory/thermo postprocessing
Coordinator routes parameter design to researcher and later stages to their existing specialist roles
permission_boundaries.important_limit: Granting the general execute tool does not create a code-enforced fixed-helper allowlist or an operating-system sandbox. The working-directory check does not confine every path that an arbitrary subprocess could access. This audit makes no such claim.
permission_boundaries.skill_overlay_limit: Skill roots and custom profiles have existing overlay precedence. read_skill's returned File identifies the selected Skill; the role configuration does not cryptographically pin it to the bundled copy.

not_verified: Live-process reload of the updated profile or Skill
New blind LLM research/delegation behavior under the Skill packaging
Materials-science correctness, potential prediction accuracy, convergence or phase transitions
Any MD execution or postprocessing capability beyond the existing role declarations
review_actions: Read-only source and documentation review, plus stdlib local link/hash checks; only this audit file was added by this reviewer. No .env contents, network sources, or actual MD data were inspected.
